path-of-the-wild-heart.summary: A barbarian who feels kinship with beasts: talks to animals and takes on an animal's gifts each time they rage.

Animal Speaker.summary: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, as Rituals only, using Wisdom.

Rage of the Wilds.summary: Each time you start a Rage, pick one animal benefit (Bear, Eagle or Wolf) that lasts while it's active.

options.name: Bear
options.summary: While raging, resist all damage types but Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant.

options.name: Eagle
options.summary: Dash and Disengage as part of the Bonus Action that starts the Rage; while raging, a Bonus Action does both again.

options.name: Wolf
options.summary: While raging, allies attack with Advantage against your enemies within 5 ft of you.

Aspect of the Wilds.summary: Pick one lasting animal trait (Owl, Panther or Salmon); swap it after any Long Rest.

options.name: Owl
options.summary: Darkvision 60 ft, or +60 ft to Darkvision you already have.

options.name: Panther
options.summary: Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Salmon
options.summary: Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

Nature Speaker.summary: Cast Commune with Nature, as a Ritual only, using Wisdom.

Power of the Wilds.summary: Each time you start a Rage, also pick Falcon, Lion or Ram for a stronger animal benefit while it lasts.

options.name: Falcon
options.summary: While raging and wearing no armor, fly at your Speed.

options.name: Lion
options.summary: While raging, enemies within 5 ft have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you or another Barbarian using Lion.

options.name: Ram
options.summary: While raging, a melee hit can knock a Large or smaller target Prone.

path-of-the-world-tree.summary: A barbarian bound to the cosmic tree, whose Rage shares life force and teleports foes and friends.

Vitality of the Tree.summary: Starting a Rage gives you temp HP equal to your Barbarian level; while raging you can hand temp HP to an ally nearby each turn.

options.name: Vitality Surge
options.summary: Gain temp HP equal to your Barbarian level whenever you start a Rage.

options.name: Life-Giving Force
options.summary: At the start of each raging turn, one other creature within 10 ft gains temp HP: roll d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus. They vanish when the Rage ends.

Branches of the Tree.summary: Reaction while raging, when a creature you see starts its turn within 30 ft: it makes a STR save or is pulled next to you, and you may drop its Speed to 0 for the turn.

Battering Roots.summary: On your turn, Heavy or Versatile melee weapons get +10 ft reach, and a hit with one can also apply Push or Topple alongside its usual mastery.

Travel along the Tree.summary: When you start a Rage, and as a Bonus Action while raging, teleport up to 60 ft. Once per Rage, make it 150 ft and take up to six willing creatures within 10 ft.

path-of-the-zealot.summary: A barbarian whose Rage is divine ecstasy, adding holy damage, self-healing and a winged battle form.

Divine Fury.summary: While raging, your first weapon or Unarmed Strike hit each turn adds 1d6 + half your Barbarian level, Necrotic or Radiant (pick each time).

Warrior of the Gods.summary: Pool of d12 healing dice (4, rising to 5 at level 6, 6 at 12, 7 at 17). Bonus Action: spend any number, roll and heal that much. Refills on a Long Rest.

Fanatical Focus.summary: Once per Rage, reroll a failed save adding your Rage Damage bonus; the new roll stands.

Zealous Presence.summary: Bonus Action: up to ten other creatures within 60 ft get Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn starts. Once per Long Rest, or spend a Rage use to reuse it.
Zealous Presence.duration: until the start of your next turn

Rage of the Gods.summary: On starting a Rage, become a divine warrior for 1 minute (or until 0 HP): flight, divine resistances, and a Rage-fuelled save for dying allies. Once per Long Rest.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly at your Speed and hover.

options.name: Resistance
options.summary: Resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

options.name: Revivification
options.summary: When a creature within 30 ft would hit 0 HP, spend a Rage use to set its HP to your Barbarian level instead.
